messages:
Maria (CSM): Nora / team — quick pre-QBR check: Atlasica's embedding traffic spiked ~3x Thu-Fri after they batch-imported legacy docs. We flagged ~$18k extra last week vs baseline. Can we triage causes + propose short term mitigations before the QBR?
Jamal (SE): saw the same. query snippet I ran: `SELECT sum(tokens) FROM usage WHERE project='atlasica' AND model LIKE '%-embed%' AND day >= '2026-03-12'` — shows big uptick starting 2026-03-14. Looks like import script used dense vectors with batch size 1.
Nora (Customer): ugh yes — we ran a migration and the team missed the streaming/mini-batch step. Sorry, that's on us. Any quick fixes that avoid re-ingesting?
Evan (FinOps): short-term options: 1) issue a one-time transient credit to cover the excess (CS-led) 2) throttle embeddings via a quota for 72h 3) recommend downsampling noncritical docs (5-10% cut) — cost impact estimate in 24h. @Maria which do you prefer?
Maria (CSM): propose (2) + (1) conditional. Throttle first so immediate burn stops, then evaluate credits if there's a migration window impact. Priya can you add a per-route quota and set alert thresholds?
Priya (Onboard Eng): will do. Proposed config: `rate_limit_per_minute: 1200`, `max_daily_tokens: 20000000` for atlasica-prod embeddings route. I'll push to their org and add an alert: `spend.delta > 30%` -> #cs-ops ping. ops-bot will confirm when applied.
ops-bot: config apply started for org:atlasica on embeddings-route. change-id: cfg-9a7c. Expected propagate: ~60s.
ops-bot: config apply complete. alert rule created: cs-embed-spike-atlasica. Severity: warning.
Jamal (SE): also recommend enabling prefix KV caching for their QA index — can cut tokens by ~12% on repeat queries. I can draft a quick how-to and a one-click toggle for their dashboard.
Nora (Customer): that'd be great. Also want to capture in QBR why this happened and our remediation timeline. Can you include a slide with root cause, mitigations, and cost delta? We need it by Tue EOD.
Evan (FinOps): I'll prepare a 1-slide cost delta + forecast: baseline run-rate, adjusted run-rate w/ throttles, and projected month-end overage. ETA Tue noon. Will include a proposed credit amount if needed.
Maria (CSM): action checklist: 1) Priya set quotas & alerts (done) 2) Jamal draft KV cache guide + quick toggle 3) Evan cost slide + credit recommendation 4) Nora confirm whether they want transient credit if migration blocked. I'll own QBR slide assembly and send draft for review by Mon 5pm.
Nora (Customer): thanks all — confirming they'd like the transient credit as a fallback. Please include the fallback amount and approval path in the slide.
Jamal (SE): quick note for engineering: add `embed_batch_size=64` to their import job and add `--stream` flag. Example: `python embed_import.py --batch-size 64 --stream=true` — reduces peak tokens and memory. I'll DM their infra lead the snippet.
Maria (CSM): perfect. I'll compile the thread into the QBR storyboard and tag reviewers. Thanks team :thumbsup:
_meta: Produced for dataset: Slack threads under customer-success about QBR/cost ops. Single-thread JSON per agents.md; messages are concatenated with sender prefixes.
